title: Donaldson's Q4 2026 Earnings Release
summary: Donaldson delivered strong financial results in fiscal 2026, achieving record sales and earnings performance. Fourth-quarter sales increased 8% to $1.1 billion, supported by improved profitability and solid operational execution across the business. For the full fiscal year, sales reached $3.9 billion, representing a 5.3% increase compared to fiscal 2025. A key milestone during the year was the successful acquisition of Facet, which further strengthens Donaldson’s position in the durable aerospace, defense, and power generation markets. The acquisition contributed positively to sales and enhanced the company’s portfolio in key growth sectors.
body_markdown:
Donaldson delivered strong financial results in fiscal 2026, achieving record sales and earnings performance. Fourth-quarter sales increased 8% to $1.1 billion, supported by improved profitability and solid operational execution across the business. For the full fiscal year, sales reached $3.9 billion, representing a 5.3% increase compared to fiscal 2025.


A key milestone during the year was the successful acquisition of Facet, which further strengthens Donaldson’s position in the durable aerospace, defense, and power generation markets. The acquisition contributed positively to sales and enhanced the company’s portfolio in key growth sectors.
